tagline: what we have built and where it stands
description: Autheo DEX: what has been built, how it is structured and where it stands. Non-custodial, compliance-gated trading and settlement for tokenized real-world assets, with agent mandates.
footer: Status checked against the build repository on 13 Oct 2026. Sandbox code, unaudited. Not an offer of securities or a regulated service.
